title.narrative: SCREAM-Sustaining Conservation and Restoration of the Eastern Arc Mountains

description.narrative: This project aims at enhancing the Eastern Arc Mountains to Provide Sufficient Quantity and Optimal Quality of Ecosystem Services including mitigating and adapting against climate change impacts. The project will also assist women and disadvantage groups in the project area with alternative livelihood activities including horticulture, livestock keeping, beekeeping and energy cooking stoves.
